articles.title: Did the President Really Call FIFA About a Soccer Player?
articles.summary: President Trump asked FIFA to review a red card for U.S. striker Folarin Balogun. FIFA then suspended the one-match ban for 12 months, so Balogun can play against Belgium. Belgium is upset and says it’s not fair.

articles.title: Prince Harry’s Palace Stay? Yes, No, Maybe… Wait, No!
articles.summary: Prince Harry is visiting London, but he won’t stay at Buckingham Palace—even though his team said he would. The Palace says he was told no on Saturday. The mix-up shows how bad the communication is between Harry and the royal family.
